InventoryApiRequest.description: Defines the information needed to submit a search query.

ApiKey.description:
Enter your assigned API key.
The assigned API key can be found on the API Credentials page.
            
Alternatively, you may provide the API key in the X-Api-Key header and omit this parameter
from the request.

CompanyId.description:
Company identifier assigned to your account.
The assigned company identifier can be found on the API Credentials page.
            
This property is deprecated, no longer required and may be omitted.

CountryCode.description:
Enter a two-character ISO code or leave blank for geolocation.

Leave this field blank if you would like us to geolocate the SourceIp parameter
and use the country that the IP address is from. If you use the TrustedParts.com API
to provide results on a website, this allows you to provide regional results to each
user without any effort on your part.

CurrencyCode.description: Enter a three-character ISO currency code. (Optional)

Distributors.description: The distributors that will be included in this search. Add this section to limit the search results to one or more distributors. Omit this section to search all authorized distributors. Our supported distributors can be found here.
example: enter a distributor name or remove the optional Distributors parameter

ExactMatch.description:
Set to true to view parts that match the search term exactly.
Set to false to include partial match results.
Note: Partial match results are only available for single part number requests.
Most punctuation and spacing are ignored when determining what is an exact match.
For instance, BAT-54C is an exact match for BAT54C.

InStockOnly.description: Set to true to view in-stock results only. (Optional)

IsCrawler.description:
Set to true if the end user is a crawler or bot (e.g. Google, Bing, Baidu).
Set to false if the end user is not a crawler or if undetermined.

LanguageCode.description:
Enter the ISO language code for part specification translations or leave blank for English.

Supported values: 

de, en, es, fr, it, pt, ja, zh-hans, zh-hant

Queries.description:
The part number(s) and manufacturer(s) you want to search for.

Add a separate query for each part number search.

Note: If you enter multiple part numbers, an exact match search will be performed
for each part number. Partial match results are only available for single part number requests.

SourceIp.description: Provide the IP (Internet Protocol) address of the end user who will view the results. Please ensure the accuracy of this value so that TrustedParts.com can verify the identity of users who receive results. Geolocation: When the CountryCode parameter is omitted or left blank, the SourceIp parameter will be used to geolocate the request and provide regional results.

UseCachedData.description:
If this parameter is not supplied or set to false, the TrustedParts.com API
will provide results based on real-time stock and pricing services provided
by participating distributors. This is the preferred setting since it yields
the most accurate results. However, if you need extremely fast responses or
need to submit a high volume of requests in a short period of time, you may
set this parameter to true. This will direct the TrustedParts.com API to use
an optimized search process that retrieves results from locally-cached data
instead of real-time data.

UserAgent.description:
Provide the user agent of the requesting application or end user's browser.
Please ensure the accuracy of this value so that TrustedParts.com can verify
the identity of users who receive results.

InventoryApiResponse.description: Search results for a search query.

CurrentDate.description: Date and time that results were returned.

ErrorMessage.description: A message regarding an error generated by the search.

PartResults.description: The search results grouped by part number searched for.

ResponseTime.description: The amount of time it took for the API to respond with results.

InventoryDistributorResult.description: Contains the information for a part that matched a search.

Links.description: Links. For example, datasheet URL or distributor product URL.

InventoryPartResult.description: Contains search result information for a part number.

IsAffectedByTariff.description: Have TrustedParts.com distributors indicated that the part is affected by tariffs in the United States?

LifecycleRisk.description:
Lifecycle risk of a matching part.
            
Please email user-requests@trustedparts.com to see if our policies allow this information
to be provided to you.

Manufacturer.description: The manufacturer name for the result.

ManufacturerId.description: The TrustedParts manufacturer ID for the result.

PartNumber.description: The manufacturer part number for the result.

ProductUrl.description: The TrustedParts.com product page for the result.

Specifications.description:
Specifications of a matching part.
            
Please email user-requests@trustedparts.com to see if our policies allow this information
to be provided to you.

SupplyChainRisk.description:
Supply Chain risk of a matching part.
            
Please email user-requests@trustedparts.com to see if our policies allow this information
to be provided to you.

PartDistributor.description: Contains the information for a distributor that has search results.

DistributorResults.description: The list of matched manufacturer parts.

PartSpecification.description: Contains part specifications for the part result.

Price.description: Contains price information for a specific quantity.

ProductCompliance.description: Contains regulatory compliance information for products.

RoHS.description: Contains regional RoHS compliance information for products.

CurrencyCode.description: Currency code for the pricing amounts (e.g., "USD").

MinimumQuantity.description: Minimum order quantity for the price.

Prices.description: List of prices for specific quantities.

RohsCompliance.description: Contains RoHS compliance information for products.

Region.description: Region for the RoHS compliance information

SearchApiLink.description: Contains a link (URL) with a type.

Manufacturers.description: The manufacturers that will be searched. Add this section to limit the search results to one more more manufacturers. Omit this section to search all authorized manufacturers. Our supported manufacturers can be found here.
example: enter a manufacturer name or remove the optional Manufacturers parameter

SearchToken.description: Enter the search term. The search term must be at least two characters and no more than 100 characters.

StockInfo.description: Contains stock information for an api search result.

Availability.description: Contains a message about stock availability. For instance, "In Stock".

QuantityOnHand.description: Indicates number of parts currently on hand. Will be null if we are not going to disclose the exact number.

info.description: Pricing and Stock information for available parts.
info.title: TrustedParts.com Inventory API

post.description: Submits a search request to the TrustedParts.com API and returns matching inventory results.
post.summary: Get TrustedParts.com Inventory API search results
